jobs.occupation: Specialist in obstetrics and gynecology in a Nordic island setting
jobs.description:

Join a welcoming healthcare team in a serene Nordic Island community, where your skills in obstetrics, including childbirth care, and a broad gynecological profile will make a significant impact. Enjoy work-life balance, professional growth and the unique lifestyle this beautiful island offers.
About the Island:
This idyllic Nordic Island is home to approximately 30,000 residents and offers a peaceful and family-friendly environment. Surrounded by stunning nature, you’ll have access to outdoor activities like hiking, sailing and cycling, along with a safe and inclusive community. The island boasts excellent schools, daycare facilities and job opportunities for partners, making it an ideal location for families.

As a specialist in obstetrics and gynecology, you will:
Provide high-quality care in obstetrics, with a strong focus on childbirth and prenatal care.
Diagnose and treat a wide range of gynecological conditions.
Work independently while collaborating with a multidisciplinary team, including midwives and nurses.
Mentor and supervise junior doctors (residents and ST-läkare), contributing to their development.
Participate in discussions to improve patient care and develop the services offered.

Requirements:
Holds an EU-recognized specialist certification in obstetrics and gynecology.
Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish (B1 or higher level).
Competence in childbirth management and a broad profile in gynecology.
Team-oriented with the ability to work independently.
An interest in guiding and teaching resident doctors.

Focus on obstetrics and gynecology
Work in a supportive environment where your expertise in childbirth and gynecology is highly valued.

Work-life balance
Shorter working hours and no on-call duties ensure you have time for personal interests and family.

Career development
Opportunities to mentor residents and contribute to the growth of the department, with the potential for leadership roles.

Quality of life
Live in a stunning natural setting with world-class outdoor activities and a relaxed lifestyle.

Family-friendly
Excellent schools, childcare facilities, and a welcoming community make this an ideal location for families.

Opportunities for partners
Diverse local jobs ensure a smooth relocation for your entire family.

jobs.occupation: ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN
jobs.description:
TAKTEAM
SEASONAL 6-MONTH EMPLOYMENT 2027
ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN
Would you like to become part of a growing company that offers good opportunities for professional development while contributing to the sustainable maintenance and protection of our customers’ homes?
Then send your application today!
Candidate selection takes place on an ongoing basis.
JOB DESCRIPTION
As a member of our team, you will represent the company to our customers while carrying out the work. Most of the work takes place in different areas of Sweden, and you will be working outdoors, on the tiled roofs of residential properties.
Your duties will include cleaning tiled roofs and facades. This is a varied job involving many different activities and procedures. Overnight travel may also be required.
At the beginning of your employment, you will receive relevant training in the use of high-pressure cleaning equipment and in working at heights. Previous experience in these areas is, of course, an additional advantage.
The work takes place in different areas of Sweden, from the west coast to the east coast. This means that, alongside your work, you will have the opportunity to experience different parts of the country and discover Sweden from a different perspective.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
This is a physically demanding job that requires good physical ability and skill in using your body, hands, and various tools.
You will work in a two-person team responsible for roof cleaning. For this reason, we place great importance on your ability to cooperate and communicate effectively, accept and handle feedback, and, above all, be willing to work hard and pull your weight when needed.
If you have a colleague or friend who is also interested in coming to work in Sweden, we would be happy to know. The possibility of starting together can make it much easier to form a team, as two people usually work together in each team. In this way, if you come together, the team can be ready from the beginning.
Roof cleaning can involve unexpected challenges related to the surface, dimensions, and similar issues. We are therefore looking for someone who is solution-oriented, is not afraid to take initiative, and can suggest creative solutions.
Naturally, we also want you to be flexible, learn quickly, and contribute to creating a good atmosphere within your team, as well as during any contact with customers.
REQUIREMENTS FOR THE POSITION
• Good knowledge of English.
• B or BE driving licence.
ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
• Good knowledge of Greek.
• Experience using high-pressure washing equipment, carpentry, roof installation/construction, or similar work involving machinery.
• Experience in the construction and assembly of scaffolding.
• Experience in cleaning and painting tiled roofs, as well as cleaning and painting facades.
WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO WORK AS A ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN AT TAKTEAM?
• A high level of freedom and responsibility in your work.
• Good opportunities for professional development.
• Variety in your daily work, with different types of tasks for our customers.
• Work in different areas of Sweden.
• Accommodation provided for the duration of your employment with us. Team members share the same apartment/accommodation.
• Statutory insurance coverage.
• Good benefits and working conditions.
• Hourly-paid employment.
• Salary is paid on the 25th of each month and covers the work performed during the previous month.
Working in different areas of Sweden is not only a professional opportunity, but also a way to experience the country, visit different places, and gain new experiences.
If you are hardworking, responsible, cooperative, and eager to develop your skills within a growing company, we would be happy to receive your application!

Join a leading University Hospital in Southwestern Sweden!
Are you a pediatric ophthalmologist from the EU looking to grow your career in a modern, academic, and supportive environment?
A leading university hospital in southwestern Sweden is now recruiting specialists in pediatric ophthalmology to strengthen its highly specialized eye care department. This is an exciting opportunity to work with advanced diagnostics and nationally designated care for pediatric glaucoma and cataract, while contributing to education, clinical development, and research within one of Sweden’s foremost ophthalmology units.
About the role
You will join a large ophthalmology department with more than 250 professionals, covering outpatient care, emergency eye services, inpatient wards, and surgical units. The pediatric ophthalmology section provides comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic care for children and collaborates closely with electrophysiology and hereditary disease units.
You will work in multidisciplinary teams that include physicians, orthoptists, nurses, optometrists, and technicians, all focused on delivering patient-centered, high-quality eye care. As part of a university hospital, you will also have the opportunity to participate in teaching, clinical research, and innovation projects.
Requirements
EU-recognized specialist certification in ophthalmology
Minimum five years of clinical experience in ophthalmology
Focus and competence in pediatric ophthalmology
Strong interest in teaching, research, and clinical development
Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Swedish
Team-oriented, responsible, and committed to providing high-quality patient care
Experience or competence in medical retina is considered an advantage

Language and relocation support
A willingness and motivation to learn Swedish is important for your integration and clinical work.
The relocation process begins once you reach language level B2. During this stage, you will work 50% clinically and study 50% Swedish until you achieve C1 level, which is required to apply for a Swedish specialist license (specialistbevis) to practice as a specialist doctor.
Language training is provided free of charge once you have accepted an employment offer.
You will receive full support throughout the licensing and relocation process, including assistance with documentation, Swedish authorization, and settling in Sweden.

jobs.occupation: Internship in Health, Safety & Environment Department
jobs.description:
Company Description

Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life".
About us
We support managers and executives in their environmental and working environment responsibilities. We comply with requirements according to laws and certifications as well as directives within the company group and communicate continuously internally.   

Job Description

Your contribution to something big
Our department drives the company's sustainability work, and your internship work will contribute to the implementation of local activities and initiatives in this area.
We also need to strengthen our team with an intern who is interested in environmental technology, has a basic understanding of ISO 14001 or similar standards.
The internship includes, among other things, environmental technology, waste management, chemical substances, reporting and project management.
We want you to have experience in problem solving, collecting and analyzing data, contributing to the development of training materials and work instructions.

Duration of the internship: 6 months, preferably starting February 2027
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden

Qualifications

What distinguishes you
You are an organizer, happy to take on projects and organize events in the area of sustainability.
Our company language is English, but we work on production projects and it would be beneficial if you could also communicate in Swedish, so a basic knowledge of Swedish is an advantage.
Ongoing studies in Industrial Engineering and Management, Sustainability Management, Safety & Environmental Engineering, or a related field.
Knowledge and experience of Microsoft Office 365 with a special emphasis on Word Excel and PowerPoint.
Good communication skills, both verbal and written.
Problem solving skills.
Please note: Only applications from students that are currently studying are accepted.

Additional Information

What we offer you
Monetary compensation is included to support you during your internship
We can offer free accommodation in Tranås
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch

jobs.occupation: We seek nurses for permanent positions in Snåsa in Norway
jobs.description:
Would you like a permanent nursing position with varied responsibilities and nature right outside your door?
On behalf of Snåsa Municipality in Trøndelag, Norway, we are seeking three registered nurses for permanent positions within the municipal healthcare and care services.
Here, you will enjoy a varied and meaningful workday, providing care and follow-up for patients both in home care services and in institutional settings. You will become part of a professional healthcare environment where nurses play a key role, with a high degree of autonomy, varied clinical responsibilities, and close collaboration with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
At the same time, you will have the opportunity to live in a place where nature is never far away. Snåsa is located next to the Blåfjella-Skjækerfjella National Park, offering vast forests, mountains, and excellent opportunities for hiking, cycling, hunting, and fishing. With a population of approximately 2,100 people, Snåsa is also a welcoming community where it is easy to get to know people and feel at home.
About the position

jobs.occupation: Internship in Project Management
jobs.description:
Company Description
Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life".

Job Description
Your contribution to something big
As part of the team, you will play an active role in planning, implementing, and monitoring projects.
You will also take independent responsibility for project streams and sub-projects and drive them forward in a targeted manner.
You will create templates and compelling presentations for our stakeholders and also provide support with administrative tasks.
With the help of sound project data analyses, you will identify key areas for improvement and thus actively contribute to our continuous development.
You will be actively involved in the development and implementation of new processes and methods in project management.
You will independently develop meaningful presentations for project management in PowerPoint, thereby preparing important decisions.
You will carefully collect all open issues in OneNote as an OPL (Open Point List) and ensure their transparency.
You will precisely monitor the consistent tracking of milestones and deliverables to ensure continuous project progress.

Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Currently studying in business administration, economics, engineering, project management, or similar as Master student
Solution-oriented mindset
Ability to work independently and to take responsibility for own work
Experience in proficient in MS Office; basic knowledge of project management methods and tools such as Jira or PowerBI is an advantage
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools, e.g. Word, Excel, Power Point
You are characterized by a reliable, structured, and independent approach as well as clear and open communication; you think analytically, can quickly familiarize yourself with complex issues, and enjoy proactively developing innovative solutions with creative ideas; you enjoy working in a dynamic team
Enthusiasm: for new projects; you are motivated to continuously develop yourself both personally and professionally through the use of modern methods and digital tools
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English - Swedish is an advantage

Additional Information
What we offer you
We offer monetary compensation to support you during your internship.
Free accommodation in Tranås is provided
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

At Bosch, we care for you, our business, and our environment. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid. We grow together into countless roles, positions, and opportunities and we are interested in developing the “whole” you, not just the “7 to 16” you, because life is all about balance.
At Bosch we understand that everyone has their own focus in life, whether it is about new professional challenges, training, and development, or more time for family, friends, and hobbies, whatever your goals are we are flexible. Let ‘s strike a balance. At Bosch, we believe everyone is different and that is what we love. Get inspired by a cooperative, open, respectful, and trustworthy workplace where you can be yourself and be enriched by the perspectives of our community around the globe.
Join us and feel the difference. #LikeABosch

jobs.occupation: À la carte kock / À la carte chef
jobs.description:
På Camp Ripan får du möjlighet att arbeta i en unik miljö, omgiven av natur och kultur som är speciell för vår region. Vi värderar våra medarbetare högt och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du kan växa och utvecklas. Du blir en del av ett sammansvetsat team där samarbete, service och respekt för varandra är grundläggande.
I hjärtat av Camp Ripan finner du vår fantastiska restaurang där vi erbjuder frukost, lunch och middag samt möjlighet för större arrangemang. Inspirationen är hämtad ur stadens tre kulturer – den svenska, den samiska och den tornedalsfinska och det är detta som genomsyrar hela verksamheten. Nu söker vi dig som förutom ett roligt och utmanande arbete är redo för en vintersäsong i norr med storslagen fjällvärld, magiskt norrsken och fantastiska fritidsaktiviteter. 
Som medarbetare i vårt kök på Camp Ripan är du en stor del av det som gör att gästerna får en minnesvärd matupplevelse utöver det vanliga hoa oss. Här representeras vår trekulturella region i form av noggrant utvalda råvaror i spännande smakkombinationer. Camp Ripans kök är ett av Sveriges mest klimatsmarta kök, här arbetar vi med den senaste tekniken för att minimera vår påverkan på miljön. 
Vi söker nu dig som trivs med att jobba i ett drivet arbetslag, där alla deltar och påverkar den kreativa processen, från idé till färdig produkt. Du har ett levande intresse för yrket, minst 6 års erfarenhet (3 år utbildning, 3 år av arbetslivserfarenhet i à la carterestaurang), goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska. Det är meriterande om du har kunskaper inom den lokala matkulturen och dess råvaror eftersom det är grunden i vår matfilosofi.  
Personalboende finns att tillgå vid behov. Särskild visstidsanställning på 100%. Intervjuer sker löpande och anställning sker när vi hittat rätt person för tjänsten. 
 
At Camp Ripan, you will have the opportunity to work in a unique environment, surrounded by the nature and culture that make our region special. We value our employees and offer a workplace where you can grow and develop. You will become a part of a close-knit team where collaboration, service, and respect for one another are fundamental.
At the heart of Camp Ripan you find our fantastic restaurant, where we serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner, as well as hosting larger events and gatherings. Our inspiration comes from the three cultures of Kiruna – Swedish, Sámi, and Tornedalian-Finnish – which are reflected throughout our entire operation. We are now looking for someone who is ready for an exciting and challenging job, as well as the opportunity to experience a winter season in the spectacular mountain landscape, magical Northern Lights, and fantastic outdoor activities.
As a member of our kitchen team at Camp Ripan, you will play an important role in creating memorable dining experiences for our guests. Our three-cultural region is represented through carefully selected local ingredients and exciting combinations of flavors. Camp Ripan's kitchen is one of Sweden's most climate-conscious kitchens, and we use modern technology and sustainable methods to minimize our environmental impact.
We are looking for someone who enjoys working as part of a motivated kitchen team, where everyone contributes to and influences the creative process, from the initial idea to the finished dish. You have a genuine passion for the profession and at least six years of experience (three years of education and three years of professional experience in an à la carte restaurant). Good knowledge of Swedish and/or English is required. Knowledge of local food culture and regional ingredients is considered an advantage, as these form the foundation of our culinary philosophy.
Staff accommodation is available if needed. This is a full-time temporary position (100%). Interviews are conducted continuously, and employment will begin once we have found the right candidate for the position.

jobs.occupation: Specialist in General Surgery - Nordic Island
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Have you been considering a career change but have not yet found the right opportunity?
Are you looking for a position where you can work across a broad range of surgery, take responsibility, and at the same time enjoy a healthy work-life balance? Then this could be the opportunity for you.
We are looking for a Specialist in General Surgery to join a smaller acute care hospital located on a Nordic island in a unique setting. Here, you will have the opportunity to work broadly within surgery and become an important part of a close-knit clinical team.
About the position
The surgical department offers a broad scope of practice and is not divided into narrow subspecialty sections. This means you will work with a varied patient population and have the opportunity to use a wide range of your surgical skills.
The work includes gastrointestinal surgery, gallbladder and hernia surgery, colorectal surgery, proctology, endoscopy and acute surgery. Both open and laparoscopic surgery are performed.
Endoscopy is a natural part of the surgical practice and includes both gastroscopy and colonoscopy.
Working at a smaller acute care hospital means that the working day can vary considerably. You should therefore enjoy a broad surgical role and feel confident assessing and managing a range of surgical conditions.
Close collaboration and a supportive team
As a surgeon, you will become an important part of a smaller team where colleagues work closely together and support one another. Collegial support and guidance are available when needed.
We are not looking for someone who is expected to know everything. What matters is that you have broad surgical competence, sound clinical judgement, and the confidence to recognise when you may need support or wish to further develop your skills in a particular area.
The smaller hospital setting also gives you the opportunity to contribute your experience and play an active role in the continued development of the department.
Work-life balance
The position is located in a unique Nordic island environment, surrounded by the sea, archipelago and nature. It offers an attractive alternative for those seeking a different lifestyle from what is often associated with working at a large regional or university hospital.
For those who value both a professionally rewarding career and time for family, leisure and recovery, the location offers an attractive combination.
Qualifications
We are looking for a specialist who:
Holds an EU-recognised specialist qualification in General Surgery
Has broad surgical competence and experience
Has experience in gastrointestinal and acute surgery
Has experience in endoscopy, particularly gastroscopy
Is comfortable working both independently and as part of a team
Has good collaboration skills and a patient-centred approach
Is flexible and appreciates the variety that comes with working at a smaller acute care hospital
Has good English language skills
Has a strong motivation to learn Swedish. Language training is provided.

Experience in additional areas of surgery is considered an advantage.
Who are you?
You are a Specialist in General Surgery who appreciates the breadth of the specialty and enjoys working in a smaller clinical environment where collaboration, flexibility and responsibility are a natural part of everyday work.
You are confident in your professional role, collaborative and open-minded. You value being part of a close-knit team where colleagues support one another and where your experience and expertise can make a meaningful contribution to both the department and its patients.
You are also motivated to continue developing professionally and are happy to share your own knowledge and experience with colleagues.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
• Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
• Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
• Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
• Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype:
Interested?
If you are interested in this opportunity or would like to learn more, you are very welcome to contact us.
We would be happy to tell you more about the position.
We look forward to hearing from you!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.
